header.note: Measured on the base commit: the gate's decision [verdict, rule] for a main session and for a child session (child roots as in the parity harness), and the digest.
header.digest: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON (object keys sorted, no whitespace) of parseShell(command with {R} replaced by /pin-root, { platform: "linux" }) with the fields added after the base removed; the base has none of them.
header.rootToken: {R} in command and cwd stands for the fixture's root directory.
